note: Retenir commonly means keep/retain, hold back, remember, and reserve/book. The current gloss omits the high-frequency reservation and holding-back uses.
proposed_english: to keep; to retain; to hold back; to remember; to reserve/book

note: Caméra is not limited to 'movie camera' in modern French; it commonly means camera/video camera.
Cuisine means not only the room kitchen but also cooking/cuisine. Omitting that basic sense is misleading.
Société commonly means both society and a company/business/corporation. The commercial sense is too basic to omit.
Gérer should teach manage/handle/run. The source gloss 'to rule, to rock' is slang/noisy and is not an appropriate core learner definition.
proposed_english: to manage; to handle; to run

note: Fleur centrally means flower. The current entry omits 'flower' entirely and instead leads with peripheral dictionary senses.
Étranger as a noun commonly means foreigner/stranger, while as an adjective it means foreign. 'Foreigner' should be explicit.
Action centrally means action. The current entry omits that basic sense and lists only secondary meanings such as campaign, share, and special offer.
proposed_english: action; act; share/stock; campaign; special offer (retail context)

note: Remonter has common meanings go back up/climb back up, bring/raise back up, and date/go back to. 'Turn back up' is unclear learner English.
proposed_english: to go back up; to climb back up; to bring/raise back up; to wind up; to go/date back to

note: Impliquer means involve as well as imply. Omitting 'involve' removes one of its central everyday meanings.
proposed_english: to involve; to imply; to implicate
